thread:
devin: quick ping — opened PR to handle an edge case where tokenizer hits an empty-byte sequence and crashes the model load. need one more reviewer and a green CI to merge today if possible: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/4523 :eyes:
marie: can you paste the stack trace or a tiny repro? i want to be sure this won't change token offsets for existing models
sandeep: i ran the unit tests locally against the branch, saw one flaky on quantize/test_padding related to rng seed, but tokenizer-specific tests look fine. i'll +1 if ci cleans up
devin: repro: when loading tokenizer from upstream manifest with a zero-length bpe token we hit `IndexError` in tokenizer._bpe_merge. short snippet:
```python
# repro-ish
from redwood.tokenizer import load_tokenizer
load_tokenizer("/mnt/models/edgecase/manifest.json")
```
marie: thanks — that helps. did you add a changelog note? we try to include a short migration hint for any tokenizer behavior changes
devin: added changelog under docs/changes/4523.md and updated the commit message with GUID ABCD-1234. also included a tiny fuzz test to catch empty bytes.
elaine: quick ask — can you add a one-liner in model-configs/compat.md if the serialized format changes? ops will want that for Dedicated rollouts
devin: ok will do in a follow-up commit, won't block merge if folks are comfortable
sandeep: re: earlier flaky — looks like CI flaked on pytorch nightly; i've retriggered the job. if it passes i'm happy to approve
ci-bot: CI pipeline #4523 — linux-unit-tests: flaky retry queued by @sandeep
ci-bot: CI pipeline #4523 — linux-unit-tests: passed (rerun) :white_check_mark:
devin: thanks! marathon CI is green now
marie: left one tiny comment about an assertion message, otherwise looks good to me. tagging @sandeep for final review :+1:
sandeep: reviewed and left a small nits fix request, then approving after that change
devin: pushed fix for the assertion wording, new sha 0f1e2d3. thanks both
ops-bot: heads-up: if this lands today before 6pm PST, Dedicated deploy can pick it up in tonight's window; otherwise it'll be next business-day schedule
elaine: thanks ops-bot, planning note: if merged, coordinate with infra to avoid config churn for customers on pinned tokenizer versions
devin: noted. anyone want me to hold merge until infra ack?
marie: no need to hold — merge once CI is green and sandeep approves. i'll keep an eye on post-merge smoke tests :rocket:
sandeep: approved. merging after marie's check passes
devin: merging now. thanks all! :tada:
